responsibility: Implements the pointer-range semantics in GCC’s ranger operator engine. It provides the prange overloads and default stubs on range_operator, helper builders for pointer comparison result constraints, concrete folding/back-propagation/relation logic for pointer arithmetic and relational operators over prange operands, and initializes the pointer entries in range_op_table such as POINTER_PLUS_EXPR and POINTER_DIFF_EXPR so SSA range propagation can reason about pointer expressions distinctly from integer and floating operators.
